from __future__ import annotations

import json
from pathlib import Path

import pytest

WATCHDOG_PATH = ROOT / "scripts" / "noteri_control_plane_watchdog.py"

HEADLESS_WORKFLOW = ROOT / ".github/workflows/noteri-headless-control-plane-activation.yml"

PROBE_SPEC = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("noteri_control_plane_probe", PROBE_PATH)
assert PROBE_SPEC and PROBE_SPEC.loader
probe = importlib.util.module_from_spec(PROBE_SPEC)
PROBE_SPEC.loader.exec_module(probe)

WATCHDOG_SPEC = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("noteri_control_plane_watchdog", WATCHDOG_PATH)
assert WATCHDOG_SPEC and WATCHDOG_SPEC.loader
watchdog = importlib.util.module_from_spec(WATCHDOG_SPEC)

def test_probe_parses_headless_task_xml() -> None:
    raw = b"""<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<Task xmlns="http://schemas.microsoft.com/windows/2004/02/mit/task">
  <Principals><Principal><LogonType>S4U</LogonType></Principal></Principals>
  <Triggers><BootTrigger><Enabled>true</Enabled></BootTrigger></Triggers>
  <Settings><Enabled>true</Enabled></Settings>
</Task>
"""
    task = probe.parse_task_xml(raw)
    assert task == {
        "exists": True,
        "enabled": True,
        "trigger_at_startup": True,
        "logon_type": "S4U",
        "validator": "schtasks_xml",
    }
    assert probe.task_headless_ready(task) is True


def test_probe_proves_runner_without_rdc(monkeypatch) -> None:
    monkeypatch.setattr(probe, "validate_host", lambda: "Noteri")
    monkeypatch.setattr(probe, "runner_listener_detected", lambda: True)
    monkeypatch.setattr(
        probe,
        "task_status",
        lambda: {
            "exists": True,
            "enabled": True,
            "trigger_at_startup": True,
            "logon_type": "S4U",
            "validator": "schtasks_xml",
        },
    )
    monkeypatch.setattr(
        probe,
        "activation_diagnostic",
        lambda: {
            "interactive": {"exists": False},
            "elevated": {"exists": False},
        },
    )
    # Este teste de contrato do host não deve chamar gh api / rede real;
    # a lógica do registro GitHub tem testes específicos com subprocess mockado.
    monkeypatch.setattr(
        probe,
        "github_runner_registry_probe",
        lambda: {"ok": False, "state": "unit_test_no_external_probe"},
    )
    monkeypatch.setenv("RUNNER_NAME", "noteri-reqsys-dev")
    monkeypatch.setenv("RUNNER_OS", "Windows")
    monkeypatch.setenv("RUNNER_ARCH", "X64")
    result = probe.probe(probe.CONFIRM, "corr-noteri-probe")
    assert result["ok"] is True
    assert result["host"] == "Noteri"
    assert result["runner_listener_detected"] is True
    assert result["headless_ready"] is True
    assert result["headless_task"]["trigger_at_startup"] is True
    assert result["headless_task"]["logon_type"] == "S4U"
    assert result["github_runner_registry"]["state"] == "unit_test_no_external_probe"
    assert result["rdc_required"] is False
    assert result["production_touched"] is False
    assert result["secrets_read"] is False


def test_probe_sanitizes_activation_diagnostics(monkeypatch, tmp_path: Path) -> None:
    monkeypatch.setenv("LOCALAPPDATA", str(tmp_path))
    root = tmp_path / "ReqSys" / "NoteriControlPlaneWatchdog"
    root.mkdir(parents=True)
    (root / "interactive-launch-result.json").write_text(
        json.dumps(
            {
                "ok": False,
                "exit_code": 2,
                "source_sha": "a" * 40,
                "result": "interactive_launcher_exception",
                "error_type": "RuntimeError",
                "error": "falha controlada",
                "observed_at": "2026-09-21T00:00:00+00:00",
                "secret": "never-expose",
            }
        ),
        encoding="utf-8",
    )
    (root / "elevated-install-result.json").write_text(
        json.dumps(
            {
                "ok": False,
                "error_type": "WatchdogError",
                "error": "registro falhou",
                "runtime_ok": True,

                "headless_persistence": False,

    result = probe.activation_diagnostic()

    assert result["interactive"]["exit_code"] == 2
    assert "secret" not in result["interactive"]
    assert result["elevated"]["activation_pending"] is True
    assert "principal" not in result["elevated"]

def test_workflow_and_policy_are_fixed_to_noteri() -> None:
    workflow = WORKFLOW.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
    assert "runs-on: [self-hosted, Windows, X64, noteri, reqsys-dev]" in workflow
    assert "--confirm PROBE-NOTERI-CONTROL-PLANE" in workflow
    assert "shell: powershell" in workflow
    assert "shell: pwsh" not in workflow
    assert "workflow_dispatch:" in workflow
    # Exact owner-only choice: preserving the previous default while refusing
    # arbitrary user-supplied command arguments or additional modes.
    dispatch = workflow.split("on:\n", 1)[1].split("\npermissions:", 1)[0]
    expected = (
        "  workflow_dispatch:\n"
        "    inputs:\n"
        "      mode:\n"
        "        description: 'Governed qualification or Rules219 read-only inventory'\n"
        "        required: true\n"
        "        type: choice\n"
        "        default: qualification\n"
        "        options:\n"
        "          - qualification\n"
        "          - rules219_readonly\n"
        "\n"
    )
    assert dispatch == expected
    legacy = workflow.split("\\n  probe:", 1)[1].split(
        "\\n  independent_readback:", 1
    )[0]
    for required in (
        "github.repository == 'ericson-j-santos/noteri-runtime'",
        "github.ref == 'refs/heads/main'",
        "github.actor == 'ericson-j-santos'",
        "github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch'",
        "inputs.mode == 'qualification'",
    ):
        assert required in legacy


def test_watchdog_installs_hkcu_fallback_when_startup_task_denied(monkeypatch, tmp_path: Path) -> None:

    (root / ".runner").write_text("opaque", encoding="utf-8")
    (root / "run.cmd").write_text("@echo off\n", encoding="utf-8")
    (root / "bin" / "Runner.Listener.exe").write_bytes(b"stub")

    repo_root = tmp_path / "repo"
    scripts = repo_root / "scripts"
    scripts.mkdir(parents=True)
    source = scripts / "noteri_control_plane_watchdog.py"
    source.write_text(WATCHDOG_PATH.read_text(encoding="utf-8"), encoding="utf-8")

    monkeypatch.setattr(watchdog, "require_noteri", lambda: "Noteri")
    monkeypatch.setattr(watchdog, "runtime_root", lambda: tmp_path / "runtime")
    monkeypatch.setattr(
        watchdog,
        "register_task",
        lambda **kwargs: (_ for _ in ()).throw(PermissionError("Access is denied")),
    )
    monkeypatch.setattr(
        watchdog,
        "install_logon_fallback",
        lambda **kwargs: {
            "exists": True,
            "trigger": "AtLogon",
            "scope": "HKCU",
            "headless": False,
        },
    )
    monkeypatch.setattr(
        watchdog,
        "cycle",
        lambda runner_home: {"ok": True, "runner_running_after": True},
    )

    result = watchdog.install(
        repo_root,
        root,
        "a" * 40,
        watchdog.INSTALL_CONFIRM,
    )
    assert result["runtime_ok"] is True
    assert result["activation_pending"] is True
    assert result["runtime_persistent_after_login"] is True
    assert result["headless_persistence"] is False
    assert result["logon_fallback"]["scope"] == "HKCU"

def test_watchdog_creates_automation_folder_when_missing() -> None:
    class Root:
        def __init__(self) -> None:
            self.created = None

        def CreateFolder(self, name: str):
            self.created = name
            return {"folder": name}

    class Service:
        def __init__(self) -> None:
            self.root = Root()

        def GetFolder(self, path: str):
            if path == "\\":
                return self.root
            raise RuntimeError("missing")

    service = Service()
    folder = watchdog.ensure_task_folder(service)
    assert folder == {"folder": "Automation"}
    assert service.root.created == "Automation"

])

) -> None:

def test_start_runner_uses_hidden_console_in_normal(monkeypatch, tmp_path: Path) -> None:
    runner = tmp_path / "runner"
    runner.mkdir()
    (runner / "run.cmd").write_text("@echo off", encoding="utf-8")
    cmd = tmp_path / "cmd.exe"
    cmd.write_bytes(b"fake")
    monkeypatch.setenv("ComSpec", str(cmd))
    monkeypatch.setattr(watchdog, "runtime_profile", lambda: "NORMAL")
    monkeypatch.setattr(watchdog, "validate_runner_home", lambda path: runner)
    monkeypatch.setattr(watchdog, "runner_running", lambda: True)
    monkeypatch.setattr(watchdog.subprocess, "CREATE_NEW_PROCESS_GROUP", 0x200, raising=False)
    monkeypatch.setattr(watchdog.subprocess, "CREATE_NO_WINDOW", 0x08000000, raising=False)
    observed = {}

    class FakeProcess:
        pid = 12345
        def poll(self):
            return None

    def fake_popen(command, **kwargs):
        observed["command"] = command
        observed.update(kwargs)
        return FakeProcess()

    monkeypatch.setattr(watchdog.subprocess, "Popen", fake_popen)
    assert watchdog.start_runner(runner) is True
    assert observed["command"][0] == str(cmd)
    assert observed["command"][1:3] == ["/d", "/c"]
    assert observed["creationflags"] & 0x08000000
    assert observed["stdout"] is watchdog.subprocess.DEVNULL
    assert observed["stderr"] is watchdog.subprocess.DEVNULL


def _version_launcher_module(monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch):

    from types import SimpleNamespace

    monkeypatch.setattr(

def test_watchdog_installed_release_gate_rejects_redirected_release_tree(
    monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch, tmp_path: Path,
) -> None:
    launcher = _version_launcher_module(monkeypatch)
    _, source, local, release, version, meta = _installed_watchdog_fixture(tmp_path)
    external = tmp_path / "outside-approved-release"
    external.mkdir()
    (external / release.name).write_bytes(source.read_bytes())
    release.unlink()
    release.parent.rmdir()
    try:
        release.parent.symlink_to(external, target_is_directory=True)
    except (OSError, NotImplementedError) as exc:
        pytest.skip(f"symlink fixture unavailable on this runner: {type(exc).__name__}")

    # Keep the metadata on the approved lexical path. The previous resolve()-based
    # comparison followed both paths to the same external bytes and falsely passed.
    meta["release_script"] = str(release.absolute())
    monkeypatch.setattr(launcher.watchdog, "runtime_root", lambda: local)
    with pytest.raises(
        launcher.LauncherError, match="WATCHDOG_INSTALLED_PATH_REDIRECTED",
    ):
        launcher.attest_installed_release(meta, version, source)


@pytest.mark.parametrize("invalid", [
    "stale_sha", "missing_path", "other_path", "missing_file", "tampered_file",
    "metadata_digest", "unverified_task",
])
def test_watchdog_installed_release_gate_rejects_invalid_state(
    monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch, tmp_path: Path, invalid: str,
) -> None:
    launcher = _version_launcher_module(monkeypatch)
    _, source, local, release, version, meta = _installed_watchdog_fixture(tmp_path)
    monkeypatch.setattr(launcher.watchdog, "runtime_root", lambda: local)
    if invalid == "stale_sha":
        meta["source_sha"] = "b" * 40
    elif invalid == "missing_path":
        meta.pop("release_script")
    elif invalid == "other_path":
        meta["release_script"] = str(source)
    elif invalid == "missing_file":
        release.unlink()
    elif invalid == "tampered_file":
        release.write_bytes(b"tampered")
    elif invalid == "metadata_digest":
        meta["release_sha256"] = "0" * 64
    elif invalid == "unverified_task":
        meta["task"] = {"exists": False}
    with pytest.raises(launcher.LauncherError, match="WATCHDOG_INSTALLED_"):
        launcher.attest_installed_release(meta, version, source)


def test_ready_task_must_not_bypass_stale_sha_or_attempt_uac(
    monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch, tmp_path: Path,
) -> None:
    launcher = _version_launcher_module(monkeypatch)
    root, source, local, _, version, meta = _installed_watchdog_fixture(tmp_path)
    meta["source_sha"] = "b" * 40
    monkeypatch.setattr(launcher, "validate_launcher", lambda **_: None)
    monkeypatch.setattr(launcher, "load_metadata", lambda _: meta)
    monkeypatch.setattr(launcher.watchdog, "runtime_root", lambda: local)
    monkeypatch.setattr(launcher, "task_status", lambda: {
        "exists": True, "enabled": True, "trigger_at_startup": True,
        "logon_type": "S4U",
    })
    monkeypatch.setattr(launcher, "finalize", lambda *args: pytest.fail("metadata_mutated"))
    monkeypatch.setattr(launcher, "is_admin", lambda: pytest.fail("uac_attempted"))
    with pytest.raises(launcher.LauncherError, match="WATCHDOG_INSTALLED_SHA_MISMATCH"):
        launcher.launch(

            confirm=launcher.LAUNCH_CONFIRM, timeout_seconds=15,
